IURWTS (Integrated Urban Regeneration and Water Transport System Project)
- To renew & rejuvenate the major canals in the city of Kochi;
- To reclaim the river edge as a public asset, improve its spatial structure & restore the city’s relationship with the Canals;
- To create an efficient & durable infrastructure which could poster new activities in addition to supporting the current one; and
- To develop canal network for inland navigation, tourism and recreational purpose
Canals in this project – 34.98km :
- Edapally Canal – 11.23 km
- Chilavannoor Canal – 9.88 km
- Perandoor Canal – 11.15 km
- Thevara Canal – 1.41 km
- Market Canal – 0.66 km
- Konthuruthy Canal – 0.65 km
